name: Reserve and send one generation three official travel request with both native failures preserved

condition.code: local p=Players[0]; local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and b and type(b.ThirdSpyReserve)=='function'

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; assert(b.ThirdSpyStatus().bound and b.RetryLivingSpy()=='HOME_READY','third native spy must be explicitly bound and travel ready'); b.ThirdSpyReserve('SPY_TRAVEL'); return 'third travel reservation queued'

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.thirdLast; if a=='ERROR_SPY_TRAVEL' then error(a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_SPY_TRAVEL'
local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_SPY_TRAVEL' or a=='REJECTED_SPY_TRAVEL' or a=='UNKNOWN_SPY_TRAVEL' then error(a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_SPY_TRAVEL'

steps.code: ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.Queue('SAVE_TRAVEL'); return 'persist generation three accepted native travel'

condition.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; if b.lastAction=='ERROR_SAVE_TRAVEL' then error(b.lastAction) end; return Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_SPY_TRAVEL')~=nil
